decisive_items: intense uptake (SUVmax 25.5) in the right testis but no uptake in the adrenal glands
bilateral macronodular adrenal enlargement measuring 15×12 mm on the right and 27×18 mm on the left
response.rationale: Testicular mass with high FDG uptake and no adrenal uptake favors a primary testicular tumor (Leydig cell tumor) over adrenal hyperplasia, which lacks functional or metabolic evidence.

rejected.why: Adrenal nodules are non-functional (no uptake, no endocrine symptoms) and incidental; testicular findings dominate.
